scope: Standalone storage ownership/allocation optimization; actual production common.cpp and server-task.cpp with state API fault injection. GPU and combined MTP integration are parent tasks.

cases: checkpoint clone shares immutable bytes and mutation/resize/clear isolates owners
actual checkpoint update/load preserves source bytes
checkpoint clone succeeds with large allocations rejected
same-size consumed snapshot reuses initialized storage with large allocations rejected
smaller serialized lengths retain full capacity budget charge
oversized spare discarded before protected useful state eviction
reduced byte quota discards spare before useful state
failed restore evicts entry without recycling invalid storage; fresh allocation failure contained
partial write into recycled state is not published
process opt-out restores deep-copy ownership and releases consumed buffers

negative_controls.baseline: conversation + combined atomic save/restore, before storage patch
negative_controls.full_suite_failure: checkpoint clone must share immutable bytes
negative_controls.pool_only_failure: consumed snapshot storage is not charged to the cache budget

cpu_microbenchmarks.warning: Isolated CPU allocation/copy costs, not CUDA or end-to-end inference measurements. The generic memory probe is an allocation-cost audit; the checkpoint probe uses the actual patched blob class.

invariants: No arithmetic, weights, KV precision, prompt or serialization wire format changes.
All snapshot vectors and idle spare capacities enter the hard byte budget.
Oversized spare capacity is discarded rather than causing extra useful-state eviction.
Shared checkpoint capacity is charged conservatively for every cached owner.
State API and disk serialization lengths use logical size, not retained capacity.
Only complete successful restore buffers are retained; short/throwing saves are removed by the atomic prerequisite.
Storage remains pageable; no pinned cache or global allocator tuning.

process_flag.name: EZLOCALAI_LLAMA_CACHE_STORAGE
process_flag.default: enabled; includes immutable sharing and one-pair spare reuse
process_flag.does_not_disable: atomic save/restore or independent MTP fixes

independent_review.scope: All target/draft blob uses, disk templates, capacity accounting, protected eviction and exception ownership.

integration_requirements: Rebuild matched common/server consumers because checkpoint C++ field layout changes.
Slot prompt_save must call the atomic cache.save API before reused buffers can be enabled.
Combined MTP payload capacity must enter allocation and cache budget accounting.
Add the mandatory test to native package targets and all four Docker gates.
